name: shelf
display_name: shelf — Object-Storage / File-Handling / CDN / Uploads Employee
description: The Energy fleet's object-storage / file-handling / CDN / uploads employee — presigned POST policy over PUT, magic-byte upload validation, signed-URL access control, abort-incomplete-multipart lifecycle hygiene day-one, and egress-first cost. Defaults to Cloudflare R2 (zero egress) with S3 as the portability contract; picks the backend per-workload, not per-tribe. Refuses SVG-from-untrusted, object ACLs, and sizing bills from GB stored. Object storage only — DB blobs are acorn's, rate-limit/cache is echo's, session-identity is badge's. Powered by Energy.
author: Energy Platform
install_instructions:
1. Install deps and build: pnpm install && pnpm build
2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings → Plugins → Add local plugin → select this directory (or `claude plugin install shelf`).
3. Now available: the shelf CLI (presign / upload / get / validate / lifecycle / cost / backend / migrate / scan / serve-config / cors / brain / explain / eval), shelf's OWN MCP server (presign_upload / presign_get / validate_file / set_lifecycle / find_orphans / estimate_cost / pick_backend / explain_pitfall / search_brain), the 5 skills, the block-storage-footguns PreToolUse grep-gate (the dogfood: shelf's harness obeys shelf's law — it blocks object ACLs, filename-in-key, new Map() upload state, and presigned-PUT-as-size-bound), and the upload-security-auditor + storage-cost-auditor sub-agent personas.
4. The CLI also exposes `shelf-mcp` (the MCP server entrypoint) for direct stdio use; a hosted Streamable-HTTP variant serves the same 9 tools (SHELF_MCP_HTTP). The CONSUMED Cloudflare R2 MCP (cloudflare/mcp-server-cloudflare) is registered in .mcp.json with env-refs only as a lens on the R2 default — it is NOT the presign path.
